name: SkyeChip Berhad
overview: SkyeChip Berhad 于2026年5月18日在 Bursa Malaysia 主板上市，首次公开发行4亿股普通股。年内公司与 SiPearl SAS 签署谅解备忘录，涉及半导体 IP 及 IC 设计开发相关合作。最新季度（2026年9月30日）营收为5415.7万令吉，净利润为1770.6万令吉。
overview_en: SkyeChip Berhad listed on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia on 18 May 2026, with an initial public offering of 400,000,000 ordinary shares. During the year, the company entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with SiPearl SAS related to semiconductor IP and IC design and development collaboration. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was MYR 54.157 million and net profit was MYR 17.706 million.
